scrapingdog.reason: BRO-3325 (2026-09-14): flipped by the tier-skip drift audit verdict — 3% success over 1551 Scrapingdog calls in the 7d ledger (1,208 x SD "HTTP 404 This URL does not exist", 272 x 400, 232 x 500 at the 20cr stealth escalation), while the Bright Data fallthrough on the same requests succeeds 99.9% (1,058 rows fallback_from=scrapingdog). Direct curl from outside returns 403 Attention Required (Cloudflare managed challenge) — SD cannot get through it any more; the 2026-08-03 30/30 plain+stealth parity retest no longer holds. Skipping SD sends DTLI straight to BD (same tier that was already doing the work) and stops ~6.8K wasted SD credits per 1.5 days plus a failed round-trip on every poller tick. Monthly recovery probe will re-test.

scrapingdog.reason: Scraping cost v3 S1-T2 (2026-08-03): production ledger showed 22% success/301 calls over the prior 7d, below the approved <30% skip:true bar. Unlike didtheylikeit.com, no param fix rescues this — theatre.reviews' bounded-URL-construction discovery (scripts/lib/tr-roundup-discover.js) guesses a roundup URL per show and most shows never got one, so SD's '404 URL does not exist' is a genuine miss, not a provider block. Live retest (2026-08-03) confirmed Bright Data independently finds real content on URLs SD 404s (e.g. reviews-roundup/ivanov-reviews/), so BD stays in the chain unaffected — this flag only removes SD's guaranteed-wasted first hop on this domain, cutting the double-hop the card was filed for. Superseded the stale 2026-07-31 1-URL conclusion, which never saw production's real guess-heavy traffic mix.
